audio

Audio.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
id String No Unique ID of the audio component.
src String No URL of the resource to be played. The value can be a network path or a local path (ensure that the path does not exceed the root directory of the project).
loop Boolean false No Whether to enable the cyclic playback.
controls Boolean false No Whether to display the default control.
poster String No URL of the audio cover image on the default control. If the controls attribute is set to false, the poster attribute is unavailable.
name String No Audio name on the default control. If the value of the controls attribute is set to false, the name attribute is invalid.
author String No Author name on the default control. If the controls attribute is set to false, the author attribute is invalid.
binderror eventHandle No Triggered when an error occurs. The output is detail = {errMsg}.
bindplay eventHandle No Whether to trigger the play event when the playback starts or continues.
bindpause eventHandle No Whether to trigger the pause event when the playback is paused.
bindtimeupdate eventHandle No Whether to trigger the timeupdate event when the playback progress changes. The output is detail = {currentTime, duration}.
bindended eventHandle No Whether to trigger the ended event when the playback ends.

Sample Code

1. Audio Player with Playback Controls

<view class="audio-container">
  <audio id="myAudio" name="Sample Audio Track" author="Macle OpenDoc" src="https://www.soundhelix.com/examples/mp3/SoundHelix-Song-1.mp3" controls="true" style="width: 100%;" />
</view>
